    for p0 in inits:
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p:f(p)-sigma,np.array(p0,float),max_nfev=1500,xtol=1e-14,ftol=1e-14,gtol=1e-14)

            if np.isfinite(v) and (best is None or v<best[0]): best=(v,r.x)
        except Exception as e: pass
